scene: Inside the swaying gondola, soapy suds foam against the glass windows.
beats: You scrape a clean portal through thick suds, revealing spinning storm vanes just as the gondola bumps the rain barrel platform and the doors slide open wide.
The pigeon coos happily, leaves behind an iridescent feather, and swoops out into the breeze right as the cabin docks beside a bubbling cloud tank, doors parting.
Warm rain-scented mist puffs out with a cheerful whistle, billowing through the opening doors to unveil the rainbow-sprinkled rooftops waiting just outside.
picture: Flat side-view inside the enclosed gondola cabin along a metal floor line. On the far left, a cleaner grips a dripping squeegee. Centre, the player in corduroy jacket stands near a pigeon on a rail. On the far right, a shiny red valve is bolted beside the sliding doors.
shown: a long rubber squeegee dripping suds, held on the far left
a fluffy grey pigeon perched calmly on a brass rail centre
a polished red pressure valve mounted to the wall far right

after.label: Stay on
after.beat: You stay put as the gondola glides past, swaying gently through drifting drizzle. At the terminus, you hop aboard the rattling mail train, rolling straight into the cavernous, bear-filled Lost Property Depot.
after.then: Step off at Lost Property Depot

variants.scene: Sudsy foam sloshes across the glass as the cosy cabin rattles along.
beats: You glide the squeegee down, carving a clear oval to watch whirling storm vanes as the cabin nudges against the rain barrel platform and the doors glide open wide.
The gentle bird pecks eagerly, leaving a shimmering grey feather behind before flapping outside just as the car docks alongside a bubbly cloud tank with sliding doors.
A friendly hiss releases fragrant steam that curls through the cabin, drifting outward as the metal doors part to reveal shiny, rainbow-tinted rooftops outside.
variants.ride_on: You remain aboard through the gentle drizzle until the final stop, switching to the clattering mail train that rolls into the gigantic, bear-filled Lost Property Depot.

variants.scene: White soap bubbles coat the windows while you ponder {quest} in the gentle warmth.
beats: Rubber scrapes across the wet glass, framing spinning storm vanes outside just as the tram bumps the wooden barrel platform and the doors part smoothly.
The cooing pigeon accepts your treat, drops a silky feather, and flutters out the moment the cabin meets the frothing cloud tank and doors open.
Warm steam whistles into the air with a friendly toot, swirling through the newly opened doors toward glistening rooftops painted with soft rainbow colours.
variants.ride_on: You stay in your seat past the stop, riding through the mist to transfer onto the loud mail train, which carries you to the cavernous Lost Property Depot full of bears.

variants.scene: Soapy lather drips down the tall glass as the gondola sways softly.
beats: Pulling the squeegee creates a bright window showing wild storm vanes right as the gondola touches the rainy barrel platform and doors slide apart.
With a cheerful chirp, the pigeon flutters away, leaving a shiny feather behind just as the tram docks beside the bubbling cloud tank and doors slide wide.
A cloud of fresh, rain-scented vapor billows across the floor, drifting through the parting doors to show bright rooftops glittering under rainbow light.
variants.ride_on: You ride along through the misty drizzle, changing at the end of the line for a bouncy mail train that speeds into the grand, bear-filled Lost Property Depot.
